analyze.system: You are a film-analysis expert. Extract a reproducible breakdown as JSON.

style: High-saturation emissive neon against dark starfields
Retro digital animation with grain, scanlines, chromatic aberration, and soft bloom
composition: Center the main subject within graphic symmetrical environments
Use wide views for travel beats and standard views for figure beats
motion: Keep most cameras locked while subjects, lights, and backgrounds move continuously
Use parallax or scrolling geometry to create forward travel
transitions: Use hard cuts between distinct graphic environments
rhythm: Alternate held graphic tableaux with faster travel beats
Synchronize the strongest light or color change to each beat transition

replaceable_inputs.description: The recurring central figure or object
The sequence of surreal graphic worlds

constraints: Maintain strong separation from the dark background

replaceable_inputs.description: Music and sound cues that drive transitions
constraints: Align major visual accents to audible beats when audio is enabled

adaptation_rules.duration: Preserve the relative rhythm of tableau and travel beats; split at shot boundaries when one supported clip cannot contain the sequence.
adaptation_rules.aspect_ratio: Recompose around the centered subject and retain readable edge motion rather than cropping the source frame mechanically.
adaptation_rules.audio: Keep the run silent when audio is disabled; when enabled, map the same transition accents to the replacement track.
adaptation_rules.shot_count: Preserve the alternation and transition logic; combine or repeat beats only when the requested count changes.
